product_title: Royal Rose Pearl Toran with Pink Tassels
product_description: Add a touch of elegance to your home entrance with this handcrafted toran, featuring rich red roses, intricate golden detailing, sparkling embellishments, and graceful pearl drapes with pink-accented tassels. Perfect for Diwali, weddings, pooja rooms, and festive celebrations.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water, moisture, and harsh chemicals.
Handle pearls, flowers, and tassels gently.
Store in a cool, dry place after use.
